snap.title: Your free Snapshot
snap.lead: A short review prepared from your own website and profiles. Read it, keep it, use it. No obligation.

how.title: How the free Snapshot works
how.1x: Send your business name, website or Instagram, email, city and industry.
how.2x: We review your site and public profiles and write up your Snapshot: three findings with proof, one fix written out, and three posts in your brand.
how.3x: It arrives in your inbox, free and yours to keep. Nothing is published for you and there is no obligation.
ind.title: Built for local businesses
ind.lead: Owner-run shops and studios that serve one city.
ind.1x: Menu highlights, seasonal specials and opening hours. The Snapshot checks whether people can order or ask a question from your first screen.
ind.2x: Services, team and booking. The Snapshot checks whether your site shows your services and an easy way to book.
ind.3x: Class schedules, coaches and memberships. The Snapshot checks whether a new member can find a class and book.
ind.4x: Dental, physio and similar. Posts cover your team, space, services, hours and booking.
ind.4note: No health or treatment claims, and no patient photos unless you supply written consent.
ind.5x: Cleaners, repair, trades and other local businesses. Posts cover what you do, where you work and how to book.
faq.title: Straight answers
faq.1q: What do you need from me?
faq.1a1: For the free Snapshot: your business name, website or Instagram, email, city and industry.
faq.1a2: For the posts in your Snapshot, it helps if you send your logo, your brand colors if you have them, and your own photos. We don't use stock photos of strangers in your posts.
faq.2q: What do I do with the fixes?
faq.2a1: They are written out so you can paste them in, or hand them to whoever looks after your website. The posts are files for you to use. Nothing is published for you.
faq.4a1: You own the posts and captions made for you in the Snapshot and can keep using them.
faq.5a1: No. Nobody can honestly promise that. The Snapshot shows where you stand and what to fix first, with one fix and three posts written out. Results depend on your business, your market and what you do with them.
faq.7q: What languages do you work in?
faq.7a1: This site is in English, Spanish, French and Arabic, and you can write to us in any of them.
faq.9a1: We use them to prepare your Snapshot and email it to you. You can ask us to delete them any time at {email}. See the privacy page (DRAFT) for the details.

close.text: The Snapshot is free and yours to keep.

terms.intro: The terms for using crierstudio.com and for the free Snapshot.
terms.who.p: Crier Studio is not yet a registered company. Contact is by email only: {email}.
terms.offer.p1: Snapshot (free): three findings with proof from your own website or profile, one of the fixes written out in full, and three posts in your brand.
terms.offer.p2: Paid services are not on sale yet. If that changes, these terms will be updated before anything can be bought.
terms.nopromise.p: We do not promise more customers, more sales, a search ranking or any other result. What we deliver is the review, the written fix and the posts described above. What happens next depends on your business, your market and what you do with them.
terms.need.p: Accurate details, and only photos, logos and text you have the right to use. Nothing is published for you: you decide what to use.
terms.public.p: We review your site and profiles and, for comparisons, public information about similar businesses. If we cannot find comparable businesses we say so. Numbers come from public sources and can be incomplete or out of date.
terms.own.h: Ownership of what we make for you
terms.own.p: You own the posts and captions made for you in the Snapshot and may keep using them.
terms.refund.p: The Snapshot is free, so there is nothing to refund. See the refund policy (draft).
terms.limits.p: We provide the Snapshot as described on this page. Questions about these terms: {email}.
privacy.intro: What Crier Studio collects when you ask for a Snapshot on crierstudio.com, why, who sees it, how long it is kept, and how to have it deleted.
privacy.collect.p1: When you fill in the Snapshot form we collect what you type: your business name, your website or Instagram handle, your email address, your city and your industry. We also record that you ticked the box agreeing to the use below, and the time you did.
privacy.collect.p2: To limit abuse, the form's server briefly uses your connection's address to count requests. It is kept only as a scrambled value in memory for up to an hour and is not saved with your details. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies on this site.
privacy.why.p: To prepare your free Snapshot from your own website and public profiles, and to email it to the address you gave. We do not email you anything you did not ask for, and we do not sell your details.
privacy.who.p: Crier Studio (not yet a registered company) and the people who prepare Snapshots for it. Your details are stored in Crier Studio's own records system, which is hosted with a service provider (Railway). This site is hosted on GitHub Pages and its domain is handled by Cloudflare; they may see ordinary visit data such as the address of your connection. We do not share your details with anyone else unless the law requires it.
privacy.keep.p: We keep your details for up to 12 months after our last contact with you, then delete them.
privacy.del.p: Email {email} from the address you used and ask us to delete your details. We will delete them and confirm. You can also ask what we hold about you, or ask us to correct it, at the same address.
privacy.changes.p: This is a draft. The final text will replace it before it takes effect, and the date above will change.
refund.once.p: Paid services are not on sale yet, so no one is charged for anything and there is nothing to refund. If that changes, this page will be updated first.
refund.snap.p: The Snapshot is free, so there is nothing to refund.
